scientific_integrity: Symbolic proof included; standalone finite checks are corroborating rather than a proof for all sizes; explicit comparison against primary mathematical literature and OEIS; no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty Gödel chains and finite products only; generic finite Heyting algebras and infinite structures not covered. Universal background on closures, nuclear composition, and the integer sequence is already known; independent audit and comprehensive historical priority check remain outstanding.
title: Separator rigidity and exact joint-rank census for commuting nuclei of finite Gödel chains
